phases.objective: Compose the canonical durable control-plane repository, SQL execution-parent writer, and parent-aware child-evidence writer behind one verified unmounted factory while exposing exactly one child-evidence write path.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Verified SQL Runtime Composition Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: One immutable composition exposes bounded control-plane, execution-parent, and child-evidence facets bound to the same signed schema provenance, while raw components, legacy child writers, database access during creation, runtime mounting, migrations, provider dispatch, and Production readiness remain unavailable.
steps: Require current successful signed schema verification with exact deployed-runtime parity and zero blockers.
Create the canonical MySQL persistence adapter and control-plane repository internally with caller schema claims ignored.
Create the canonical parent and child SQL writers from the same pool and signed schema-verification result.
Verify the same evidence digest, database fingerprint, source commit, deployed runtime SHA, and readback cycle across the composed writers.
Expose a bounded control-plane facet that omits legacy appendJournalEvent and recordReconciliation methods.
Expose plan-item and run parent writes only through the execution-parent facet.
Expose journal and reconciliation writes only through the parent-aware child-evidence facet.
Reject raw component overrides and prove construction performs no database connection, route mount, worker mount, migration action, or provider call.
assertions: Raw pool, adapter, repository, parent writer, child writer, and full schema-verification objects are not exposed.
The legacy repository child-write methods are absent from the public control-plane facet.
The parent-aware child-evidence facet is the only public journal and reconciliation write path.
All components are canonical and share one signed schema-verification provenance.
Factory construction performs zero database connections.
runtime_mounted, route_mounted, worker_mounted, foreign_keys_enabled, migration_apply_authorized, provider_dispatch_allowed, and production_ready remain false.
